title: agent-meta Provider Registry Entries
description: Schema for the provider registry map in config/ai-providers.yaml (optionally wrapped in a top-level 'providers:' key). Enforces the provider-entry contract: known keys only, declared value types and the required identity fields (agents_dir, context_file). Unknown keys and type errors are hard validation errors (exit 1) so a typo cannot silently degrade into a provider-specific code path. Format/command keys and provider capabilities stay data (key/value), never a provider-name branch — see the provider-agnostic policy.

stringList.description: List of strings (paths, field names, model ids).

stringMap.description: Free-form string-to-string map (tool-name maps, model tiers, rename/alias tables).

mcpConfig.description: MCP registration surface of the provider. 'format' is the dispatch key every MCP writer reads; surface-formats maps a surface-version value to a format key.

committed-file.description: Committed MCP document the sync writes.

secrets-file.description: Gitignored MCP document that may carry secrets.

format.description: Resolved MCP format key (dispatch value, never a provider name).

surface-formats.description: surface-version value -> MCP format key. Selects 'mcp-config.format' at load time.

discoveryBlock.description: Optional .agents/* discovery surface (reachable only when agent-discovery is true).

agents_dir.description: Agent output directory of the discovery surface.

rules_dir.description: Rules output directory of the discovery surface.

skills_dir.description: Skills output directory of the discovery surface.

agentTransform.description: Agent-frontmatter transform contract. Every key is read by provider_transform / context writers; none of them branches on a provider name.

model-note-flat.description: Emit the model note as a flat frontmatter field.

inject-subagent-depth.description: Emit subagent_depth from the required_depth capability.

tools.description: Tools emission strategy (keep, filter, skip, remove, ...).

tools-format.description: Shape of the emitted tools block (keep, filter, map, skip).

body-note.description: Body note key added for this surface.

body-sanitize-hr.description: Sanitize horizontal rules in the agent body.

frontmatter-mechanism.description: Resolved frontmatter mechanism key (dispatch value, never a provider name).

extra-fields.description: Literal frontmatter fields emitted verbatim for this surface.

read-only-extra-fields.description: Frontmatter overrides applied to roles without Write/Edit.

providerEntry.description: One provider registry entry. Identity fields are required; every other key is optional data.

agents_dir.description: Directory the generated agent files are written to.

agent_ext.description: File extension of a generated agent file.

surface-version.description: Declared generation surface version (v1 is the byte-stable default).

model-format.description: Model-id format template applied exactly once at emission (e.g. '{model}').

model-literal.description: Literal model value emitted instead of a resolved model id.

context_file.description: Context filename the provider actually reads.

context_template.description: Template path for the generated context file.

context_adapter.description: Enables the context-adapter capability (per-provider topology only).

context_adapter_file.description: Adapter filename the provider reads instead of the shared core.

context_adapter_import.description: Import line template written into the adapter.

context_adapter_import_supported.description: Whether the provider's adapter supports an import directive.

context_adapter_settings.description: Whether the adapter is activated through the settings file.

context_filename_settings_key.description: Native settings key that points the provider at the context filename.

has_dedicated_context_file.description: Provider owns a dedicated context file (base-sync path).

personal_agents_file.description: Whether AGENTS.personal.md is generated for this provider.

has_rules.description: Whether rules are written to a dedicated rules directory.

rules_apply_to.description: applyTo frontmatter value of path-scoped rule files.

has_hooks.description: Whether a hooks directory / settings surface is configured.

hook_protocol.description: Hook event/payload contract key (verified protocol only is synced).

hook-command-anchor.description: Prefix prepended to every registered hook command.

has_commands.description: Whether the provider owns a project-level command surface.

has_prompt_commands.description: Whether commands are emitted as prompt files.

commands_ext.description: File extension of a generated command file.

commands_format.description: Command file format key (dispatch value, never a provider name).

commands_managed_index.description: Managed-index filename for the commands directory.

has_settings.description: Whether a settings document is written.

settings_template.description: Template path for the committed settings document.

settings_local_template.description: Template path for the local settings document.

settings-allow-dirs-key.description: Dotted native settings key that carries the additional-directories allow-list.

has_plugins.description: Static plugin capability flag (surface-version may override via data).

plugin_ext.description: File extension of a generated plugin file.

plugin_protocol.description: Verified native plugin runtime protocol key.

surface-plugin-protocols.description: surface-version value -> verified plugin protocol key.

runtime_gate-mechanism.description: Runtime-gate mechanism key (dispatch value, never a provider name).

bash_tool_name.description: Native shell tool name, or null when the provider has no shell tool.

extension_dir.description: Project extension directory this provider owns.

extension_hook_path.description: Extension hook path the provider reads; providers without it get the Extension-Hook lines stripped.

external_plugins_file.description: User-level file that lists externally installed plugins (duplicate-plugin warning).

path.description: Path of the user-level plugin document.

enabled_key.description: Key inside that document which lists the enabled plugins.

isolation-mechanism.description: Isolation mechanism key (dispatch value, never a provider name).

isolation-display-name.description: Human-readable provider name in isolation diagnostics.

orchestrator_hint.description: Routing hint rendered into the project context file.

planning_mode_hint.description: Planning-mode hint rendered into the project context file.

primary-role.description: Role promoted to the provider's primary agent (e.g. orchestrator).

cli-files.description: surface-version value -> committed CLI settings filename.
